ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 제사장들과 레위인들에게 더미들에 대해 물었다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 제사장들과 레위인들에게 그 더미들에 대해 물었다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 제사장들과 레위인들에게 그 더미들에 대해 자세히 물어보았다.

decisions.choice: inquired: asked for an account
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek or ask carefully. Hezekiah wants to know why the heaps are still standing, and whether the priests and Levites are being supplied; Azariah's answer in verse 10 explains.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו עֲזַרְיָ֧הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הָרֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֣ית צָד֑וֹק וַ֠יֹּאמֶר מֵהָחֵ֨ל הַתְּרוּמָ֜ה לָבִ֣יא בֵית־יְהוָ֗ה אָכ֨וֹל וְשָׂב֤וֹעַ וְהוֹתֵר֙ עַד־לָר֔וֹב כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֣ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר אֶת־הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַזֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said to him Azariah the priest, the head, of [the] house of Zadok, and said, from beginning the contribution to bring [into the] house of Yahweh, eating and being satisfied and leaving over to abundance, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and the [thing] left over [is] this abundance.

en.L: And Azariah the priest, the chief, of the house of Zadok, said to him, and he said, "Since [they] began to bring the contribution into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [we have been] eating and being satisfied and leaving over in abundance, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; and what is left over [is] this great amount."
en.B: Azariah the chief priest, of the family of Zadok, answered him, "Since the people began to bring the contributions into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, we have eaten our fill, with plenty left over, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. This great amount is what is left."
en.R: Azariah, the chief priest, who was from the family of Zadok, answered, "Ever since the people started bringing their gifts to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, we have had all we could eat, and there has been a lot left over. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. That is why so much is left."

es.L: Y le habló el sacerdote Azarías, el jefe, de la casa de Sadoc, y dijo: «Desde que comenzaron a traer la ofrenda a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, [hemos estado] comiendo y saciándonos, y ha sobrado en abundancia, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; y lo que ha sobrado [es] esta gran cantidad».
es.B: Azarías, el sumo sacerdote, de la familia de Sadoc, le respondió: «Desde que el pueblo comenzó a traer las ofrendas a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hemos comido hasta saciarnos, y ha sobrado mucho, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Esta gran cantidad es lo que ha sobrado».
es.R: Azarías, el sumo sacerdote, que era de la familia de Sadoc, le respondió: «Desde que la gente comenzó a traer sus ofrendas al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hemos tenido todo lo que podíamos comer, y ha sobrado mucho. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Por eso ha sobrado tanto».

fr.L: Et le prêtre Azaria, le chef, de la maison de Tsadoq, lui parla et dit : « Depuis qu’on a commencé à apporter l’offrande dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, [nous avons] mangé, et été rassasiés, et il en est resté en abondance, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; et ce qui reste [est] cette grande quantité. »
fr.B: Le grand prêtre Azaria, de la famille de Tsadoq, lui répondit : « Depuis que le peuple a commencé à apporter les offrandes dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, nous avons mangé à satiété et il en est resté beaucoup, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Cette grande quantité, c’est ce qui reste. »
fr.R: Azaria, le grand prêtre, qui était de la famille de Tsadoq, a répondu : « Depuis que le peuple a commencé à apporter ses dons au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, nous avons eu tout ce qu’il fallait pour manger, et il en est resté beaucoup. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. C’est pour cela qu’il en reste autant. »

sw.L: Naye Azaria kuhani, mkuu, wa nyumba ya Sadoki, akamwambia, akasema, "Tangu [walipo]anza kuleta matoleo katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [tumekuwa] tukila na kushiba na kusaza kwa wingi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; na kilichosazwa [ni] wingi huu."
sw.B: Azaria kuhani mkuu, wa jamaa ya Sadoki, akamjibu, "Tangu watu walipoanza kuleta matoleo katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tumekula na kushiba, na kumebaki mengi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Wingi huu ndio uliobaki."
sw.R: Azaria, kuhani mkuu, aliyetoka katika jamaa ya Sadoki, akajibu, "Tangu watu walipoanza kuleta zawadi zao katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tumekuwa na chakula cha kutosha, na kumebaki kingi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Ndiyo sababu kumebaki kiasi kikubwa hivi."

vi.L: Thầy tế lễ A-xa-ria, vị đứng đầu, thuộc nhà Xa-đốc, nói với vua rằng: "Từ khi [người ta] bắt đầu đem lễ vật vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [chúng tôi] ăn, được no nê và còn dư rất nhiều, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; và phần còn dư [là] số lớn này."
vi.B: Thầy thượng tế A-xa-ria, thuộc dòng họ Xa-đốc, thưa với vua: "Từ khi dân chúng bắt đầu đem lễ vật vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng tôi đã ăn no nê mà còn dư rất nhiều, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Số lớn này là phần còn dư."
vi.R: A-xa-ria, thầy thượng tế, thuộc gia đình Xa-đốc, thưa: "Từ khi dân chúng bắt đầu đem lễ vật đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng tôi đã có đủ ăn, mà còn dư rất nhiều. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì vậy mới còn dư nhiều như thế này."

ko.L: 그리고 사독의 집안의 우두머리 제사장 아사랴가 그에게 말하여 말했다. "[백성이] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 예물을 가져오기 시작한 때부터, [저희가] 먹고 배부르고 많이 남겼습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 복을 주셨기 때문입니다. 그리고 남은 것이 이 많은 양입니다."
ko.B: 사독 집안의 대제사장 아사랴가 대답했다. "백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 예물을 가져오기 시작한 뒤로, 저희가 배불리 먹고도 많이 남았습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 복을 주셨기 때문입니다. 이렇게 많은 것이 남은 것입니다."
ko.R: 사독 집안 출신의 대제사장 아사랴가 대답했다. "백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 예물을 가져오기 시작한 뒤로, 저희는 먹을 것을 넉넉히 먹었는데도 많이 남았습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성에게 복을 주셨습니다. 그래서 이렇게 많이 남았습니다."

decisions.choice: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok
decisions.reason: Zadok served as priest under David and became Solomon's chief priest (1 Kings 2:35); the chief priests after him came from his family (1 Chronicles 5:34-41, Hebrew numbering). This Azariah may or may not be the priest who stood up to Uzziah (26:17-20).

decisions.choice: the contribution: the gifts set apart for the sanctuary and its servants
decisions.reason: The word names what is lifted off and set apart from one's goods for Yahweh; in the law it covers the portions that went to the priests and Levites (Numbers 18:8-11, 24).

decisions.choice: eating, being satisfied and leaving over: the priests have had more than enough, again and again
decisions.reason: The three verbs are in a form that names the action without a person or time. The setting shows that the speaker means himself and his fellow priests and Levites, from the time the gifts began until now.

decisions.choice: eat and leave over: the language of Yahweh's supply
decisions.reason: The same pair of verbs is used when Yahweh feeds a hundred men with a small gift of bread: "they will eat and have some left over" (2 Kings 4:43-44).

decisions.choice: answered him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "said to him ... and said" around the long name and title; Balanced and Readable say it once. Balanced and Readable also name "the people" as those who brought the gifts.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ לְהָכִ֧ין לְשָׁכ֛וֹת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּכִֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Hezekiah to prepare chambers in [the] house of Yahweh, and they prepared [them].

en.L: And Hezekiah said to prepare chambers in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they prepared [them].
en.B: Then Hezekiah gave orders to prepare storerooms in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they prepared them.
en.R: Hezekiah ordered them to get storerooms ready in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, and they did.

es.L: Y Ezequías dijo que prepararan cámaras en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y [las] prepararon.
es.B: Entonces Ezequías ordenó que prepararan almacenes en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y los prepararon.
es.R: Ezequías ordenó que prepararan almacenes en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y así lo hicieron.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias dit de préparer des chambres dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et on [les] prépara.
fr.B: Ézéchias ordonna alors d’aménager des réserves dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et on les aménagea.
fr.R: Ézéchias a donné l’ordre de préparer des réserves dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et on l’a fait.

sw.L: Hezekia akasema kuandaa vyumba katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakaviandaa.
sw.B: Kisha Hezekia akaamuru vyumba vya kuhifadhia viandaliwe katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakaviandaa.
sw.R: Hezekia aliwaamuru waandae vyumba vya kuhifadhia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nao wakafanya hivyo.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia truyền chuẩn bị các phòng trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ chuẩn bị [chúng].
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ê-xê-chia ra lệnh chuẩn bị các kho chứa trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ chuẩn bị xong.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia ra lệnh cho họ dọn sẵn các kho chứa trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ làm theo.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 방들을 준비하라고 말하자, 그들이 준비했다.
ko.B: 그러자 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 창고들을 마련하라고 명령했고, 그들은 창고들을 마련했다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 창고들을 준비하라고 명령했고, 그들은 그대로 했다.

decisions.choice: chambers: rooms built around the temple courts, used for storing gifts and supplies
decisions.reason: The temple had side rooms around its courts where the priests and Levites kept the offerings, the tithes and the temple goods (1 Chronicles 9:26; 28:12; Nehemiah 13:4-5, 12).

decisions.choice: storerooms
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what these rooms were for here; Literal keeps "chambers".

decisions.choice: "cámaras" (L); "almacenes" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what these rooms were for here, as the English does (m1).

source.text: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־הַתְּרוּמָ֧ה וְהַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֛ר וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם נָגִיד֙ כָּֽנַנְיָ֣הוּהַלֵּוִ֔י וְשִׁמְעִ֥י אָחִ֖יהוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they brought the contribution and the tithe and the holy things in faithfulness; and over them [as] chief officer [was] Conaniah the Levite, and Shimei his brother [was] second.

en.L: And they brought in the contribution and the tithe and the holy things faithfully; and over them [as] ruler [was] Conaniah the Levite, and Shimei his brother [was] second.
en.B: They faithfully brought in the contributions, the tithes and the holy gifts. Conaniah the Levite was the chief officer over them, with his brother Shimei next in rank.
en.R: They were faithful in bringing in the gifts, the tenth parts and the holy gifts. Conaniah, a Levite, was in charge of all of it, and his brother Shimei was his assistant.

es.L: Y trajeron la ofrenda, y el diezmo, y las cosas consagradas fielmente; y sobre ellos [como] jefe [estaba] Conanías el levita, y Simei su hermano [era] el segundo.
es.B: Trajeron fielmente las ofrendas, los diezmos y las cosas consagradas. El levita Conanías era el encargado principal, y su hermano Simei le seguía en rango.
es.R: Fueron fieles en traer las ofrendas, las décimas partes y los dones santos. Conanías, un levita, estaba a cargo de todo, y su hermano Simei era su ayudante.

fr.L: Et ils apportèrent l’offrande, et la dîme, et les choses saintes, fidèlement ; et chef sur eux [était] Konania le Lévite, et Shiméï son frère [était] le second.
fr.B: Ils apportèrent fidèlement les offrandes, les dîmes et les dons consacrés. Konania le Lévite en était le responsable, avec son frère Shiméï comme adjoint.
fr.R: Ils ont apporté fidèlement les dons, les dixièmes et les dons saints. Konania, un Lévite, était responsable de tout cela, et son frère Shiméï était son adjoint.

sw.L: Wakaleta matoleo na zaka na vitu vitakatifu kwa uaminifu; na juu yake [kama] mkuu [alikuwa] Konania Mlawi, na Shimei ndugu yake [alikuwa] wa pili.
sw.B: Walileta kwa uaminifu matoleo, zaka na vitu vitakatifu. Konania Mlawi alikuwa msimamizi mkuu wa vitu hivyo, na ndugu yake Shimei alikuwa wa pili kwake.
sw.R: Waliyaleta kwa uaminifu matoleo, sehemu za kumi na zawadi takatifu. Konania, Mlawi, alikuwa msimamizi wa vitu hivyo vyote, na ndugu yake Shimei alikuwa msaidizi wake.

vi.L: Họ trung tín đem vào lễ vật, phần mười và các vật thánh; người cai quản chúng [là] Cô-na-nia người Lê-vi, và Si-mê-i em ông [là] người thứ hai.
vi.B: Họ trung tín đem vào các lễ vật, phần mười và các vật thánh. Cô-na-nia người Lê-vi là quan coi sóc các thứ ấy, và Si-mê-i em ông là phó.
vi.R: Họ trung tín đem vào các lễ vật, phần mười và các vật thánh. Cô-na-nia, một người Lê-vi, chịu trách nhiệm về mọi thứ đó, và Si-mê-i em ông là người phụ tá.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 예물과 십일조와 거룩한 것들을 성실하게 들여왔다. 그리고 그것들 위에 레위인 고나냐가 책임자였고, 그의 동생 시므이가 둘째였다.
ko.B: 그들은 예물과 십일조와 거룩한 예물을 성실하게 들여왔다. 레위인 고나냐가 그것들을 맡은 책임자였고, 그의 동생 시므이가 그다음 자리에 있었다.
ko.R: 그들은 예물과 10분의 1과 거룩한 예물을 성실하게 들여왔다. 레위인 고나냐가 그것을 모두 맡았고, 그의 동생 시므이가 그를 도왔다.

decisions.choice: in faithfulness: honestly and reliably
decisions.reason: The word means steadiness and trustworthiness. Those who brought in and stored the gifts could be relied on to handle them honestly; the word returns in verses 15 and 18.

decisions.choice: chief officer: the man in charge of the stores
decisions.reason: The word is often used of a ruler or prince, but in Chronicles it also names the officer at the head of a part of the temple's work (1 Chronicles 9:11, 20; 26:24).

decisions.choice: Conaniah: the name as the text is to be read
decisions.reason: The written letters of the name and the form marked in the margin for reading differ slightly; both give the same name, which appears again in verse 13.

decisions.choice: the gifts, the tenth parts
decisions.reason: Readable uses common words for "contributions" and "tithes".

decisions.choice: his assistant
decisions.reason: Readable says what "second" means: the next in charge, who helped Conaniah.

decisions.choice: ruler (Literal); chief officer (Balanced); in charge (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "ruler", the usual word for this title; Balanced and Readable say what the office was, as for the temple title in 1 Chronicles 9:11.

decisions.choice: "Conanías", "Simei"; "el segundo" (L); "le seguía en rango" (B); "su ayudante" (R)
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms of the names; Readable says what "second" means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "chef" (Literal); "le responsable" (Balanced, Readable); "Konania"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the usual word for this title, Balanced and Readable say what the office was, as the English; the name is spelled with K for the Hebrew k.

decisions.choice: "Si-mê-i em ông"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say who is older; Shimei is "second" to Conaniah, so he is taken as the younger brother. Uncertain: the Hebrew does not say.

decisions.choice: "성실하게" for "in faithfulness", here and in verses 15 and 18
decisions.reason: The word is used of handling the gifts honestly (m1); "성실하게" fits that everyday trust, while 신실 is kept for faithfulness to God.

source.text: וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וַ֠עֲזַזְיָהוּ וְנַ֨חַת וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֜ל וִֽירִימ֤וֹת וְיוֹזָבָד֙ וֶאֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְיִסְמַכְיָ֔הוּ וּמַ֖חַת וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ פְּקִידִ֗ים מִיַּ֤ד כָּֽנַנְיָ֨הוּ֙ וְשִׁמְעִ֣י אָחִ֔יו בְּמִפְקַד֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ נְגִ֥יד בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jehiel and Azaziah and Nahath and Asahel and Jerimoth and Jozabad and Eliel and Ismachiah and Mahath and Benaiah [were] overseers under [the] hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by [the] appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah [the] chief officer of [the] house of God.

en.L: And Jehiel and Azaziah and Nahath and Asahel and Jerimoth and Jozabad and Eliel and Ismachiah and Mahath and Benaiah [were] overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
en.B: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath and Benaiah were overseers under Conaniah and his brother Shimei, appointed by King Hezekiah and by Azariah the chief officer of the house of God.
en.R: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath and Benaiah were supervisors under Conaniah and his brother Shimei. King Hezekiah and Azariah, the official in charge of God's temple, had chosen them for this work.

es.L: Y Jehiel, y Azazías, y Nahat, y Asael, y Jerimot, y Jozabad, y Eliel, e Ismaquías, y Mahat, y Benaía [eran] supervisores bajo la mano de Conanías y de Simei su hermano, por designación del rey Ezequías y de Azarías, jefe de la casa de Dios.
es.B: Jehiel, Azazías, Nahat, Asael, Jerimot, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismaquías, Mahat y Benaía eran supervisores bajo las órdenes de Conanías y de su hermano Simei, nombrados por el rey Ezequías y por Azarías, el encargado principal de la casa de Dios.
es.R: Jehiel, Azazías, Nahat, Asael, Jerimot, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismaquías, Mahat y Benaía eran supervisores bajo Conanías y su hermano Simei. El rey Ezequías y Azarías, el encargado del templo de Dios, los habían escogido para este trabajo.

fr.L: Et Yehiel, et Azazia, et Nahath, et Asahel, et Yerimoth, et Yozabad, et Éliel, et Yismakia, et Mahath, et Benaya [étaient] surveillants sous la main de Konania et de Shiméï son frère, par la désignation du roi Ézéchias et d’Azaria, chef de la maison de Dieu.
fr.B: Yehiel, Azazia, Nahath, Asahel, Yerimoth, Yozabad, Éliel, Yismakia, Mahath et Benaya étaient surveillants sous les ordres de Konania et de son frère Shiméï, nommés par le roi Ézéchias et par Azaria, le responsable de la maison de Dieu.
fr.R: Yehiel, Azazia, Nahath, Asahel, Yerimoth, Yozabad, Éliel, Yismakia, Mahath et Benaya étaient contrôleurs sous les ordres de Konania et de son frère Shiméï. Le roi Ézéchias et Azaria, le responsable du temple de Dieu, les avaient choisis pour ce travail.

sw.L: Na Yehieli na Azazia na Nahathi na Asaheli na Yerimothi na Yozabadi na Elieli na Ismakia na Mahathi na Benaya [walikuwa] wasimamizi chini ya mkono wa Konania na Shimei ndugu yake, kwa uteuzi wa Hezekia mfalme na Azaria mkuu wa nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.B: Yehieli, Azazia, Nahathi, Asaheli, Yerimothi, Yozabadi, Elieli, Ismakia, Mahathi na Benaya walikuwa wasimamizi chini ya Konania na ndugu yake Shimei, walioteuliwa na mfalme Hezekia na Azaria msimamizi mkuu wa nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.R: Yehieli, Azazia, Nahathi, Asaheli, Yerimothi, Yozabadi, Elieli, Ismakia, Mahathi na Benaya walikuwa wasimamizi chini ya Konania na ndugu yake Shimei. Mfalme Hezekia na Azaria, afisa aliyesimamia hekalu la Mungu, ndio waliowachagua kwa kazi hii.

vi.L: Giê-hi-ên, A-xa-xia, Na-hát, A-sa-ên, Giê-ri-mốt, Giô-xa-bát, Ê-li-ên, Ích-ma-kia, Ma-hát và Bê-na-gia [là] những người giám sát dưới tay Cô-na-nia và Si-mê-i em ông, theo sự bổ nhiệm của vua Ê-xê-chia và A-xa-ria, người cai quản nhà Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Giê-hi-ên, A-xa-xia, Na-hát, A-sa-ên, Giê-ri-mốt, Giô-xa-bát, Ê-li-ên, Ích-ma-kia, Ma-hát và Bê-na-gia là những người giám sát dưới quyền Cô-na-nia và Si-mê-i em ông, do vua Ê-xê-chia và A-xa-ria, quan coi sóc nhà Đức Chúa Trời, bổ nhiệm.
vi.R: Giê-hi-ên, A-xa-xia, Na-hát, A-sa-ên, Giê-ri-mốt, Giô-xa-bát, Ê-li-ên, Ích-ma-kia, Ma-hát và Bê-na-gia là những người giám thị làm việc dưới quyền Cô-na-nia và Si-mê-i em ông. Vua Ê-xê-chia và A-xa-ria, người coi sóc đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời, đã chọn họ cho công việc này.

ko.L: 그리고 여히엘과 아사시야와 나핫과 아사헬과 여리못과 요사바드와 엘리엘과 이스마갸와 마핫과 브나야는 히스기야 왕과 하나님의 집의 책임자 아사랴가 정한 대로, 고나냐와 그의 동생 시므이의 손 아래 있는 감독들이었다.
ko.B: 여히엘, 아사시야, 나핫, 아사헬, 여리못, 요사바드, 엘리엘, 이스마갸, 마핫, 브나야는 고나냐와 그의 동생 시므이 아래에서 일하는 감독들이었다. 그들은 히스기야 왕과 하나님의 집의 책임자 아사랴가 세운 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 여히엘, 아사시야, 나핫, 아사헬, 여리못, 요사바드, 엘리엘, 이스마갸, 마핫, 브나야는 고나냐와 그의 동생 시므이 아래에서 일하는 감독들이었다. 히스기야 왕과 하나님의 성전을 맡은 관리 아사랴가 그들을 뽑아 이 일을 맡겼다.

decisions.choice: by the appointment of Hezekiah and Azariah: both the king and the chief priest appointed them
decisions.reason: The king and the chief priest act together in setting up the stores, as the king acts with the priests elsewhere in the reform (29:20-24). The phrase could also be read as naming Azariah as the officer over all of them, but the simplest reading joins him to the king in the appointing.

decisions.choice: chief officer of the house of God: the chief priest in his role of running the temple
decisions.reason: The same title is given to a chief priest in 1 Chronicles 9:11. Azariah is the chief priest of verse 10.

decisions.choice: under the hand of: working under the authority of
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for authority: the ten men answered to Conaniah and Shimei.

decisions.choice: supervisors
decisions.reason: Readable uses a common word for "overseers".

decisions.choice: the ruler of the house of God (Literal); the chief officer of the house of God (Balanced); the official in charge of God's temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as the same title in 1 Chronicles 9:11 and verse 12.

source.text: וְקוֹרֵ֨א בֶן־יִמְנָ֤ה הַלֵּוִי֙ הַשּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַמִּזְרָ֔חָה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים לָתֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְקָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper to the east, [was] over [the] freewill offerings of God, to give [the] contribution of Yahweh and [the] holy things of the holy things.

en.L: And Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east, [was] over the freewill offerings of God, to give out the contribution of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the holy things of the holy things.
en.B: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, keeper of the East Gate, had charge of the freewill offerings made to God, to give out the contributions for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the most holy gifts.
en.R: Kore son of Imnah, a Levite who guarded the East Gate, was in charge of the gifts people chose to give to God. He gave out the gifts that had been given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the most holy offerings.

es.L: Y Coré hijo de Imna, el levita, portero del oriente, [estaba] a cargo de las ofrendas voluntarias para Dios, para repartir la ofrenda {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y las cosas santísimas.
es.B: El levita Coré hijo de Imna, portero de la puerta Oriental, estaba a cargo de las ofrendas voluntarias hechas a Dios, para repartir las ofrendas para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y los dones santísimos.
es.R: Coré hijo de Imna, un levita que vigilaba la puerta Oriental, estaba a cargo de los dones que la gente decidía dar a Dios. Repartía los dones que habían sido dados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y las ofrendas santísimas.

fr.L: Et Koré fils de Yimna, le Lévite, le portier de l’orient, [était] préposé aux offrandes volontaires faites à Dieu, pour distribuer l’offrande {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et les choses très saintes.
fr.B: Koré, fils de Yimna, le Lévite, gardien de la porte de l’Est, était chargé des offrandes volontaires faites à Dieu, pour distribuer les offrandes réservées {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et les dons très saints.
fr.R: Koré, fils de Yimna, un Lévite qui gardait la porte de l’Est, était responsable des dons que les gens choisissaient de faire à Dieu. Il distribuait les dons faits {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et les offrandes très saintes.

sw.L: Naye Kore mwana wa Imna Mlawi, bawabu wa upande wa mashariki, [alikuwa] juu ya sadaka za hiari za Mungu, kugawa matoleo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na vitu vitakatifu vya vitu vitakatifu.
sw.B: Kore mwana wa Imna Mlawi, bawabu wa Lango la Mashariki, alisimamia sadaka za hiari zilizotolewa kwa Mungu, ili kugawa matoleo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na vitu vitakatifu sana.
sw.R: Kore mwana wa Imna, Mlawi aliyelinda Lango la Mashariki, alisimamia zawadi ambazo watu walichagua wenyewe kumpa Mungu. Aligawa zawadi zilizotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na sadaka zilizo takatifu sana.

vi.L: Cô-rê con trai Im-na, người Lê-vi, người giữ cổng phía đông, [coi sóc] các lễ vật tự nguyện dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời, để phân phát lễ vật dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các vật chí thánh.
vi.B: Cô-rê con trai Im-na, người Lê-vi, người giữ Cổng Đông, coi sóc các lễ vật tự nguyện dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời, để phân phát các lễ vật dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các lễ vật chí thánh.
vi.R: Cô-rê con trai Im-na, một người Lê-vi canh giữ Cổng Đông, chịu trách nhiệm về những lễ vật người ta tự ý dâng cho Đức Chúa Trời. Ông phân phát các lễ vật đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và các lễ vật chí thánh.

ko.L: 그리고 동쪽 문지기인 레위인 임나의 아들 고레가 하나님의 자원 예물을 맡아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드린 예물과 지극히 거룩한 것들을 나누어 주었다.
ko.B: 동문을 지키는 레위인 임나의 아들 고레는 하나님께 드리는 자원 예물을 맡아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드린 예물과 지극히 거룩한 예물을 나누어 주었다.
ko.R: 동문을 지키는 레위인인 임나의 아들 고레는 사람들이 스스로 원해서 하나님께 드린 예물을 맡았다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드린 예물과 가장 거룩한 제물을 나누어 주었다.

decisions.choice: the gatekeeper at the east: keeper of the main gate of the temple
decisions.reason: The east gate faced the entrance of the temple, and its keepers held the chief post among the gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 9:18; 26:14, 17).

decisions.choice: freewill offerings: gifts given by choice, not because the law required them
decisions.reason: A freewill offering was given out of a willing heart, apart from any vow or duty (Leviticus 7:16; Deuteronomy 16:10).

decisions.choice: the holy things of the holy things: the most holy portions, which only the priests could eat
decisions.reason: Some parts of the offerings were called most holy: the grain offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings, eaten only by the priests in a holy place (Leviticus 2:3; 6:10, 18; Numbers 18:9-10).

decisions.choice: to give: to hand out to those entitled to them
decisions.reason: Kore's task was to share out what came in among the priests and Levites.

decisions.choice: the most holy gifts (Balanced); the most holy offerings (Readable)
decisions.reason: The doubled phrase "holy of holies" means "most holy"; Literal keeps the Hebrew shape.

decisions.choice: "las cosas santísimas" (L); "los dones santísimos" (B); "las ofrendas santísimas" (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish "santísimo" gives the sense of the doubled "holy of holies" in one word (m3) at every level.

decisions.choice: "les choses très saintes" at Literal
alternatives: les choses saintes des choses saintes
decisions.reason: French says "very holy" for the Hebrew doubled phrase at every level; the literal doubling would not read as a superlative in French.

decisions.choice: "자원 예물" for the freewill offerings
decisions.reason: A plain compound for gifts given by choice (m2); Readable explains it.

source.text: וְעַל־יָד֡וֹ עֵ֣דֶן וּ֠מִנְיָמִן וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֧הוּ וּשְׁכַנְיָ֛הוּ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה לָתֵ֤ת לַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ בְּמַחְלְק֔וֹת כַּגָּד֖וֹל כַּקָּטָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And under his hand [were] Eden and Miniamin and Jeshua and Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah, in [the] cities of the priests, in faithfulness, to give to their brothers by divisions, as the great as the small,

en.L: And under his hand [were] Eden and Miniamin and Jeshua and Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in faithfulness, to give to their brothers by divisions, the great as the small,
en.B: Under him, in the towns of the priests, were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah, who faithfully gave out portions to their fellow priests and Levites by their divisions, to the great and the small alike,
en.R: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah helped him in the towns where the priests lived. They could be trusted to give out shares to their relatives by their groups, to everyone alike, from the greatest to the least.

es.L: Y bajo su mano [estaban] Edén, y Miniamín, y Jesúa, y Semaías, Amarías y Secanías, en las ciudades de los sacerdotes, con fidelidad, para dar a sus hermanos por turnos, tanto al grande como al pequeño,
es.B: Bajo sus órdenes, en las ciudades de los sacerdotes, estaban Edén, Miniamín, Jesúa, Semaías, Amarías y Secanías, que repartían fielmente las porciones a sus hermanos sacerdotes y levitas según sus turnos, por igual al grande y al pequeño,
es.R: Edén, Miniamín, Jesúa, Semaías, Amarías y Secanías lo ayudaban en las ciudades donde vivían los sacerdotes. Se podía confiar en ellos para repartir las porciones a sus parientes según sus grupos, a todos por igual, desde el más grande hasta el más pequeño.

fr.L: Et sous sa main [étaient] Éden, et Minyamin, et Yeshoua, et Shemaya, Amaria et Shekania, dans les villes des prêtres, fidèlement, pour donner à leurs frères par classes, au grand comme au petit,
fr.B: Sous ses ordres, dans les villes des prêtres, il y avait Éden, Minyamin, Yeshoua, Shemaya, Amaria et Shekania, qui distribuaient fidèlement les parts à leurs frères, par classes, aux grands comme aux petits,
fr.R: Éden, Minyamin, Yeshoua, Shemaya, Amaria et Shekania l’aidaient dans les villes où habitaient les prêtres. On pouvait leur faire confiance pour distribuer les parts à leurs frères, par groupes, à tous de la même manière, du plus grand au plus petit.

sw.L: Na chini ya mkono wake [walikuwa] Edeni na Miniamini na Yeshua na Shemaya, Amaria na Shekania, katika miji ya makuhani, kwa uaminifu, kuwapa ndugu zao kwa zamu, wakubwa kama wadogo,
sw.B: Chini yake, katika miji ya makuhani, walikuwa Edeni, Miniamini, Yeshua, Shemaya, Amaria na Shekania, waliogawa kwa uaminifu sehemu kwa makuhani na Walawi wenzao kwa zamu zao, wakubwa na wadogo vivyo hivyo,
sw.R: Edeni, Miniamini, Yeshua, Shemaya, Amaria na Shekania walimsaidia katika miji walimoishi makuhani. Waliaminika kugawa sehemu kwa jamaa zao kwa vikundi vyao, kwa kila mtu sawasawa, tangu mkubwa hadi mdogo.

vi.L: Dưới tay ông [có] Ê-đen, Mi-ni-a-min, Giê-sua, Sê-ma-gia, A-ma-ria và Sê-ca-nia, trong các thành của thầy tế lễ, cách trung tín, để phân phát cho anh em mình theo từng ban, người lớn cũng như người nhỏ,
vi.B: Dưới quyền ông, trong các thành của thầy tế lễ, có Ê-đen, Mi-ni-a-min, Giê-sua, Sê-ma-gia, A-ma-ria và Sê-ca-nia, là những người trung tín phân phát phần cho anh em mình là thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi theo từng ban, người lớn cũng như người nhỏ,
vi.R: Ê-đen, Mi-ni-a-min, Giê-sua, Sê-ma-gia, A-ma-ria và Sê-ca-nia giúp ông tại các thành nơi các thầy tế lễ sống. Họ là những người đáng tin cậy để chia phần cho bà con mình theo từng nhóm, cho mọi người như nhau, từ người lớn nhất đến người nhỏ nhất.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 손 아래에 에덴과 미냐민과 예수아와 스마야와 아마랴와 스가냐가 제사장들의 성읍들에서, 성실하게 그들의 형제들에게 반열대로, 큰 자에게나 작은 자에게나 똑같이 나누어 주었다.
ko.B: 그의 아래에서 에덴과 미냐민과 예수아와 스마야와 아마랴와 스가냐가 제사장들의 성읍들에서 일했다. 그들은 그들의 동료 제사장들과 레위인들에게 반열에 따라, 높은 사람에게나 낮은 사람에게나 똑같이 몫을 성실하게 나누어 주었다.
ko.R: 에덴과 미냐민과 예수아와 스마야와 아마랴와 스가냐는 제사장들이 사는 성읍들에서 고레를 도왔다. 그들은 믿을 만한 사람들이었다. 그들은 친족들에게 무리별로 몫을 나누어 주었고, 높은 사람이든 낮은 사람이든 모두 똑같이 대했다.

decisions.choice: the cities of the priests: the towns given to the priests to live in
decisions.reason: Thirteen towns in Judah and Benjamin were given to the priests (Joshua 21:9-19; 1 Chronicles 6:39-45, Hebrew numbering). Many priests and Levites lived there when they were not on duty at the temple, so the portions had to reach them at home.

decisions.choice: the great as the small: everyone alike
decisions.reason: The pair covers everyone, whether important or not, older or younger; no one was passed over.

decisions.choice: their brothers: their fellow priests and Levites
decisions.reason: "Brothers" is used for members of the same tribe or the same service, not only for sons of one father.

decisions.choice: gave out portions to their fellow priests and Levites
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies "portions" as the object of the giving, and says who "their brothers" were.

decisions.choice: the record ends with a comma
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 16, which says who was or was not included; Literal and Balanced end this record with a comma. Readable makes each verse a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: Literal and Balanced close the Korean sentence in this verse; verse 16 begins as a qualification of it ("... 외에")
alternatives: ending the record with a comma, as the English does
decisions.reason: A Korean sentence cannot run on after its final verb; the giving is completed here, and verse 16 is attached to it as a phrase that begins with what was set apart from it.

source.text: מִלְּבַ֞ד הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לִזְכָרִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁל֤וֹשׁ שָׁנִים֙ וּלְמַ֔עְלָה לְכָל־הַבָּ֥א לְבֵית־יְהוָ֖ה לִדְבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ לַעֲב֣וֹדָתָ֔ם בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: apart from their being enrolled, to males from a son of three years and upward, to everyone coming to [the] house of Yahweh for [the] matter of a day in its day, for their service in their duties according to their divisions.

en.L: apart from their enrollment by genealogy, of males from three years old and upward, everyone who came into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for the duty of each day in its day, for their service in their duties according to their divisions.
en.B: apart from the males three years old and up who were enrolled in the genealogies, all who came into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to do the work each day required, serving in their duties by their divisions.
en.R: This was apart from the males three years old and older who were listed in the family records, who went into {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple to do each day's work, serving in their duties by their groups.

es.L: aparte de los inscritos en su genealogía, los varones de tres años para arriba, todos los que entraban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para la tarea de cada día en su día, para su servicio en sus funciones según sus turnos.
es.B: aparte de los varones de tres años para arriba que estaban inscritos en las genealogías, todos los que entraban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para hacer el trabajo que cada día requería, sirviendo en sus funciones según sus turnos.
es.R: Esto no incluía a los varones de tres años para arriba que estaban anotados en los registros de familia, que entraban en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para hacer el trabajo de cada día, sirviendo en sus funciones según sus grupos.

fr.L: en dehors de leur inscription généalogique, des mâles depuis l’âge de trois ans et au-dessus, à tous ceux qui entraient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour la tâche de chaque jour en son jour, pour leur service dans leurs fonctions selon leurs classes.
fr.B: en dehors des hommes de trois ans et plus inscrits dans les généalogies, tous ceux qui entraient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour faire le travail que chaque jour demandait, dans leurs fonctions selon leurs classes.
fr.R: Cela ne comptait pas les garçons et les hommes de trois ans et plus inscrits dans les listes de familles, qui entraient dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pour faire le travail de chaque jour, chacun dans sa fonction et selon son groupe.

sw.L: mbali na kuandikishwa kwao kwa nasaba, wanaume tangu mwana wa miaka mitatu na zaidi, kila aliyeingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kazi ya kila siku katika siku yake, kwa huduma yao katika zamu zao kulingana na vikundi vyao.
sw.B: mbali na wanaume wenye umri wa miaka mitatu na zaidi walioandikishwa katika orodha za nasaba, wote walioingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kufanya kazi iliyotakiwa kila siku, wakihudumu katika zamu zao kwa vikundi vyao.
sw.R: Hii haikuwahusu wanaume wenye umri wa miaka mitatu na zaidi walioandikwa katika kumbukumbu za jamaa, walioingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kufanya kazi ya kila siku, wakihudumu katika kazi zao kwa vikundi vyao.

vi.L: ngoài những người được ghi tên trong gia phả, là các người nam từ ba tuổi trở lên, mọi người vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm phận sự mỗi ngày theo ngày của mình, để phục vụ trong các chức vụ theo từng ban của họ.
vi.B: không kể những người nam từ ba tuổi trở lên đã được ghi tên trong gia phả, tức là mọi người vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm công việc mỗi ngày đòi hỏi, phục vụ trong các chức vụ theo từng ban của họ.
vi.R: Việc này không kể những người nam từ ba tuổi trở lên đã có tên trong gia phả, là những người vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm công việc mỗi ngày, phục vụ trong các phận sự theo nhóm của mình.

ko.L: 족보에 등록된 3세 이상의 남자들, 곧 날마다 그날의 일을 위해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어와 반열에 따라 직무를 맡아 섬기는 모든 자들 외에 [그렇게 했다].
ko.B: 다만 족보에 오른 3세 이상의 남자들로서, 날마다 그날에 맡은 일을 하러 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어와 반열에 따라 직무를 맡아 섬기는 사람들은 이 몫에서 빠졌다.
ko.R: 그러나 족보에 오른 3세 이상의 남자들 가운데서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어가 반열에 따라 날마다 그날의 일을 하는 사람들은 이 몫을 받지 않았다.

decisions.choice: apart from: the portions in the towns did not include the men on duty at the temple
decisions.reason: The word usually means "besides" or "apart from". The likely sense is that the men who came to the temple for their turn of service were fed there from the offerings, so the officers in the towns gave to everyone else. It could also mean "in addition to", so that both groups received portions.

decisions.choice: three years old: as the text stands
decisions.reason: Boys of three would hardly come into the temple to serve. The text may mean that the males were enrolled from that age and fed with their fathers, or the number may once have been "thirty", which differs by a small change in Hebrew and is the age at which Levites began full service in Numbers 4:3. The text as it stands says three, and that is kept.

decisions.choice: the matter of a day in its day: the work required on each day
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of a daily share or duty, set for each day as it comes (Exodus 5:13; 1 Chronicles 16:37).

decisions.choice: This was apart from
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and supplies "This was" to connect it to verse 15.

source.text: וְאֵ֨ת הִתְיַחֵ֤שׂ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑עְלָה בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the enrollment of the priests by [the] house of their fathers, and the Levites from a son of twenty years and upward, in their duties by their divisions;

en.L: And the enrollment of the priests [was] by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their duties by their divisions;
en.B: The priests were enrolled by their ancestral families, and the Levites from twenty years old and up by their duties and their divisions,
en.R: The priests were listed by their families. The Levites twenty years old and older were listed by their duties and their groups.

es.L: Y la inscripción de los sacerdotes [era] según la casa de sus padres, y la de los levitas de veinte años para arriba, según sus funciones y sus turnos;
es.B: Los sacerdotes estaban inscritos por familias, y los levitas de veinte años para arriba, por sus funciones y sus turnos,
es.R: Los sacerdotes estaban anotados por familias. Los levitas de veinte años para arriba estaban anotados según sus funciones y sus grupos.

fr.L: Et l’inscription des prêtres [se faisait] selon la maison de leurs pères, et les Lévites depuis l’âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, dans leurs fonctions selon leurs classes ;
fr.B: Les prêtres étaient inscrits selon leurs familles, et les Lévites de vingt ans et plus selon leurs fonctions et leurs classes,
fr.R: Les prêtres étaient inscrits par familles. Les Lévites de vingt ans et plus étaient inscrits selon leurs fonctions et leurs groupes.

sw.L: Na kuandikishwa kwa makuhani [kulikuwa] kwa nyumba ya baba zao, na Walawi tangu mwana wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, katika zamu zao kwa vikundi vyao;
sw.B: Makuhani waliandikishwa kwa jamaa za mababu zao, na Walawi wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi kwa kazi zao na vikundi vyao,
sw.R: Makuhani waliandikwa kwa jamaa zao. Walawi wenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi waliandikwa kwa kazi zao na vikundi vyao.

vi.L: Còn việc ghi tên các thầy tế lễ [là] theo gia tộc của họ, và người Lê-vi từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên, theo các chức vụ và các ban của họ;
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ được ghi tên theo gia tộc, và người Lê-vi từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên được ghi tên theo chức vụ và theo ban của họ,
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ được ghi tên theo gia đình. Người Lê-vi từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên được ghi tên theo phận sự và theo nhóm của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들의 등록은 그들의 조상의 집에 따라, 레위인들은 20세 이상으로 그들의 직무와 그들의 반열에 따라 [했다].
ko.B: 제사장들은 가문에 따라 족보에 올랐고, 20세 이상의 레위인들은 직무와 반열에 따라 족보에 올랐다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 집안별로 명단에 올랐다. 20세 이상의 레위인들은 맡은 일과 무리별로 명단에 올랐다.

decisions.choice: the enrollment of the priests: the list by which portions were given
alternatives: and they gave to the enrolled priests
decisions.reason: The verse begins with the word that marks an object, as if it continues the giving of verse 15: the officers gave to those on the priests' list and the Levites' list. It may also simply state how the lists were kept. The sense is the same: the lists decided who received a portion.

decisions.choice: the Levites from twenty years old: as David had ordered
decisions.reason: David lowered the age at which Levites began serving to twenty (1 Chronicles 23:24, 27).

decisions.choice: house of their fathers (Literal); ancestral families (Balanced); families (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this phrase in these books.

source.text: וּלְהִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּכָל־טַפָּ֧ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֥ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָתָ֖ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: and to enroll with all their little ones, their wives and their sons and their daughters, to all [the] assembly; for in their faithfulness they consecrated themselves [in] holiness.

en.L: and to the enrolled with all their little ones, their wives and their sons and their daughters, for all the assembly; for in their faithfulness they consecrated themselves [in] holiness.
en.B: and to all who were enrolled with them: their little children, their wives, their sons and their daughters, the whole company. For they had been faithful in keeping themselves holy.
en.R: The shares also went to everyone listed with them: their little children, wives, sons and daughters, the whole group. For the priests and Levites had been faithful in keeping themselves holy.

es.L: y a los inscritos con todos sus pequeños, sus mujeres, y sus hijos, y sus hijas, para toda la asamblea; porque en su fidelidad se santificaron [en] santidad.
es.B: y a todos los inscritos con ellos: sus niños pequeños, sus mujeres, sus hijos y sus hijas, toda la comunidad. Porque habían sido fieles en mantenerse santos.
es.R: Las porciones también se daban a todos los que estaban anotados con ellos: sus niños pequeños, sus esposas, sus hijos y sus hijas, todo el grupo. Porque los sacerdotes y los levitas habían sido fieles en mantenerse santos.

fr.L: et pour les inscrits avec tous leurs petits enfants, leurs femmes, et leurs fils, et leurs filles, pour toute l’assemblée ; car dans leur fidélité ils se consacrèrent en sainteté.
fr.B: ainsi que tous ceux qui étaient inscrits avec eux : leurs petits enfants, leurs femmes, leurs fils et leurs filles, toute la communauté. Car ils avaient été fidèles à se garder saints.
fr.R: Les parts allaient aussi à tous ceux qui étaient inscrits avec eux : leurs petits enfants, leurs femmes, leurs fils et leurs filles, tout le groupe. Car les prêtres et les Lévites avaient été fidèles et s’étaient gardés saints.

sw.L: na kwa walioandikishwa pamoja na watoto wao wadogo wote, wake zao na wana wao na binti zao, kwa kusanyiko lote; kwa maana katika uaminifu wao walijitakasa katika utakatifu.
sw.B: na kwa wote walioandikishwa pamoja nao: watoto wao wadogo, wake zao, wana wao na binti zao, kundi lote. Kwa maana walikuwa waaminifu katika kujiweka watakatifu.
sw.R: Sehemu hizo ziliwafikia pia wote walioandikwa pamoja nao: watoto wao wadogo, wake zao, wana wao na binti zao, kundi zima. Kwa maana makuhani na Walawi walikuwa waaminifu katika kujiweka watakatifu.

vi.L: và cho những người được ghi tên cùng với tất cả con nhỏ, vợ, con trai và con gái của họ, cho cả hội chúng; vì họ đã trung tín thánh hóa chính mình [trong] sự thánh khiết.
vi.B: và cho mọi người được ghi tên cùng với họ: con nhỏ, vợ, con trai và con gái, tức là cả cộng đồng ấy. Vì họ đã trung tín giữ mình thánh khiết.
vi.R: Các phần cũng được chia cho mọi người có tên chung với họ: con nhỏ, vợ, con trai và con gái, tức là cả nhóm. Vì các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi đã trung tín giữ mình thánh khiết.

ko.L: 그리고 온 회중을 위해, 그들의 모든 어린아이와 아내와 아들과 딸과 함께 등록된 자들에게도 [나누어 주었다]. 그들이 성실하게 자신을 거룩하게 구별했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들과 함께 족보에 오른 모든 사람, 곧 그들의 어린아이들과 아내들과 아들들과 딸들, 온 무리에게도 몫을 나누어 주었다. 그들이 성실하게 자신을 거룩하게 지켰기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들과 함께 명단에 오른 모든 사람, 곧 그들의 어린아이들과 아내들과 아들들과 딸들, 온 무리도 몫을 받았다. 제사장들과 레위인들은 자신을 거룩하게 지키는 일에 성실했기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: and to the enrolled: the portions also went to the families on the lists
decisions.reason: The verse continues the giving of verse 15: the whole households of the priests and Levites, children included, received a share.

decisions.choice: in their faithfulness they consecrated themselves: they kept themselves holy and faithful in their service
decisions.reason: The word for faithfulness can also mean a position of trust (1 Chronicles 9:22, 26). Then the sense would be that in their office of trust they kept themselves holy. Either way the reason given is the priests' and Levites' faithful, holy service, which is why their families were provided for.

decisions.choice: to all the assembly: the whole company of priests and Levites with their families
decisions.reason: "Assembly" here is the whole group on the lists, not the gathering of all Israel.

decisions.choice: The shares also went to ... the priests and Levites
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and names who received and who had kept themselves holy.

source.text: וְלִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים בִּשְׂדֵ֨י מִגְרַ֤שׁ עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּכָל־עִ֣יר וָעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לָתֵ֣ת מָנ֗וֹת לְכָל־זָכָר֙ בַּכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּלְכָל־הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ בַּלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And for [the] sons of Aaron, the priests, in [the] fields of [the] pastureland of their cities, in every city and city, [there were] men who were designated by names to give portions to every male among the priests and to every [one] enrolled among the Levites.

en.L: And for the sons of Aaron, the priests, in the fields of the pastureland of their cities, in each and every city, [there were] men who were designated by name to give portions to every male among the priests and to everyone enrolled among the Levites.
en.B: For the descendants of Aaron, the priests, who lived in the pasturelands around their towns, there were men in every town who were named to give portions to every male among the priests and to everyone enrolled among the Levites.
en.R: Aaron's descendants, the priests, also lived on the farmland around their towns. In every town, men were chosen by name to give shares to every male priest and to every Levite who was listed in the family records.

es.L: Y para los hijos de Aarón, los sacerdotes, en los campos de los ejidos de sus ciudades, en cada ciudad, [había] hombres designados por nombre para dar porciones a todo varón de entre los sacerdotes y a todo inscrito de entre los levitas.
es.B: Para los descendientes de Aarón, los sacerdotes, que vivían en los ejidos alrededor de sus ciudades, había en cada ciudad hombres nombrados para dar porciones a todos los varones de entre los sacerdotes y a todos los inscritos de entre los levitas.
es.R: Los descendientes de Aarón, los sacerdotes, también vivían en las tierras de cultivo alrededor de sus ciudades. En cada ciudad se escogieron hombres por nombre para dar porciones a todos los sacerdotes varones y a todos los levitas que estaban anotados en los registros de familia.

fr.L: Et pour les fils d’Aaron, les prêtres, dans les champs des pâturages de leurs villes, dans chaque ville, [il y avait] des hommes désignés par leur nom pour donner des parts à tout mâle parmi les prêtres et à tout inscrit parmi les Lévites.
fr.B: Pour les descendants d’Aaron, les prêtres qui habitaient dans les pâturages autour de leurs villes, il y avait dans chaque ville des hommes désignés par leur nom pour donner des parts à tous les hommes parmi les prêtres et à tous ceux qui étaient inscrits parmi les Lévites.
fr.R: Les descendants d’Aaron, les prêtres, vivaient aussi sur les terres autour de leurs villes. Dans chaque ville, on avait choisi des hommes par leur nom pour donner des parts à tous les prêtres de sexe masculin et à tous les Lévites inscrits sur les listes de familles.

sw.L: Na kwa wana wa Haruni, makuhani, katika mashamba ya malisho ya miji yao, katika kila mji, mji, [walikuwako] watu waliotajwa kwa majina ili kugawa sehemu kwa kila mwanamume kati ya makuhani na kwa kila aliyeandikishwa kati ya Walawi.
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya wazao wa Haruni, makuhani, walioishi katika maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka miji yao, kulikuwa na watu katika kila mji waliotajwa kwa majina ili kugawa sehemu kwa kila mwanamume kati ya makuhani na kwa kila aliyeandikishwa kati ya Walawi.
sw.R: Wazao wa Haruni, makuhani, waliishi pia katika mashamba yaliyozunguka miji yao. Katika kila mji watu walichaguliwa kwa majina ili kugawa sehemu kwa kila kuhani mwanamume na kwa kila Mlawi aliyeandikwa katika kumbukumbu za jamaa.

vi.L: Còn cho con cháu A-rôn, các thầy tế lễ, ở trong các cánh đồng thuộc đồng cỏ quanh các thành của họ, trong mỗi thành, mỗi thành, [có] những người được chỉ định đích danh để phân phát phần cho mọi người nam trong các thầy tế lễ và cho mọi người có tên trong gia phả người Lê-vi.
vi.B: Còn đối với các thầy tế lễ, dòng dõi A-rôn, sống trong các đồng cỏ chung quanh thành mình, thì trong mỗi thành đều có những người được chỉ định đích danh để phân phát phần cho mọi người nam trong các thầy tế lễ và cho mọi người có tên trong gia phả người Lê-vi.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ, dòng dõi A-rôn, cũng sống trên những vùng đất ruộng chung quanh thành của họ. Trong mỗi thành, có những người được chọn đích danh để chia phần cho mọi thầy tế lễ nam và mọi người Lê-vi có tên trong gia phả.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 성읍들의 목초지 들판에 [사는] 아론의 자손 제사장들을 위해서도, 성읍마다 성읍마다 이름이 지명된 사람들이 있어서, 제사장들 가운데 모든 남자와 레위인들 가운데 등록된 모든 자에게 몫을 나누어 주었다.
ko.B: 자기 성읍 주변의 목초지에 사는 아론의 자손 제사장들을 위해서도, 성읍마다 이름이 불린 사람들이 있어서 제사장들 가운데 모든 남자와 레위인들 가운데 족보에 오른 모든 사람에게 몫을 나누어 주었다.
ko.R: 아론의 자손인 제사장들은 자기 성읍 주변의 들판에서도 살았다. 성읍마다 이름이 뽑힌 사람들이 있어서, 모든 남자 제사장과 명단에 오른 모든 레위인에게 몫을 나누어 주었다.

decisions.choice: the fields of the pastureland: the open land around the priests' towns
decisions.reason: Each town given to the priests and Levites had land around it for their herds and flocks (Numbers 35:2-5; Leviticus 25:34). Those who lived out there were also reached.

decisions.choice: every city and city: each and every town
decisions.reason: Repeating the noun means "every single one".

decisions.choice: designated by names: chosen and listed by name
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used of men named for a task (1 Chronicles 12:32; 16:41; 2 Chronicles 28:15).

decisions.choice: Aaron's descendants ... also lived on the farmland around their towns. In every town ...
decisions.reason: Readable splits the verse into two sentences and says "farmland" for the pastureland.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ כָּזֹ֛את יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכָל־יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ וְהָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And did like this Hezekiah in all Judah, and he did the good and the right and the faithfulness before Yahweh his God.

en.L: And Hezekiah did like this in all Judah, and he did what was good and what was right and what was faithful before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.
en.B: Hezekiah did this throughout Judah. He did what was good and right and faithful before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.
en.R: Hezekiah did this all through Judah. He did what was good, right and faithful in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.

es.L: Y así hizo Ezequías en todo Judá, e hizo lo bueno, y lo recto, y lo fiel delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.B: Así hizo Ezequías en todo Judá. Hizo lo bueno, lo recto y lo fiel delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.R: Ezequías hizo esto en todo Judá. Hizo lo bueno, lo recto y lo fiel en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias fit ainsi dans tout Juda, et il fit ce qui est bon, et ce qui est droit, et ce qui est fidèle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.B: Voilà ce que fit Ézéchias dans tout Juda. Il fit ce qui est bon, droit et fidèle devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.R: Ézéchias a agi ainsi dans tout Juda. Il a fait ce qui est bon, juste et fidèle, sous le regard {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu.

sw.L: Hezekia akafanya hivyo katika Yuda yote, akafanya yaliyo mema na yaliyo sawa na yaliyo ya uaminifu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.
sw.B: Hezekia alifanya hivyo katika Yuda yote. Alifanya yaliyo mema, yaliyo sawa na ya uaminifu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.
sw.R: Hezekia alifanya hivyo katika Yuda yote. Alifanya yaliyo mema, sawa na ya uaminifu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia làm như vậy trong cả Giu-đa; vua làm điều tốt, điều ngay thẳng và điều trung tín trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia làm như vậy khắp Giu-đa. Vua làm điều tốt, điều ngay thẳng và điều trung tín trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia làm như vậy khắp Giu-đa. Vua làm điều tốt, điều đúng và điều trung tín trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 온 유다에서 이와 같이 행했다. 그리고 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 선하고 올바르고 진실한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 온 유다에서 이렇게 했다. 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 선하고 올바르고 진실하게 행했다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 유다 온 땅에서 이렇게 했다. 그는 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시는 앞에서 선하고 옳고 진실한 일을 했다.

decisions.choice: faithful: true and reliable
decisions.reason: The word means truth, firmness and faithfulness. Here it describes the king's conduct: loyal and true to Yahweh. In Kings, Hezekiah prays that he has walked before Yahweh "in faithfulness" with a whole heart (2 Kings 20:3).

decisions.choice: good and right before Yahweh: the verdict on Hezekiah, made fuller
decisions.reason: Chronicles has already said that Hezekiah did what was right in Yahweh's sight (29:2; 2 Kings 18:3). Here it adds "good" and "faithful", and says "before" Yahweh rather than "in his eyes": the king lived his life in Yahweh's presence.

decisions.choice: in the presence of
decisions.reason: Readable makes "before" clear: in the sight of Yahweh.

records.literal_gloss: And in every work that he began in [the] service of [the] house of God, and in the law and in the commandment, to seek his God, with all his heart he did, and prospered.

en.L: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law and in the commandment, to seek his God, with all his heart he did [it], and he prospered.
en.B: Every work he took up in the service of the house of God, and in keeping the law and the commandments, he did with all his heart, seeking his God; and he prospered.
en.R: He served God's temple and obeyed God's law and commands in everything he started, because he wanted to seek his God. He put his whole heart into it, and he was successful.

es.L: Y en toda obra que comenzó en el servicio de la casa de Dios, y en la ley y en el mandamiento, para buscar a su Dios, lo hizo con todo su corazón, y prosperó.
es.B: Toda obra que emprendió en el servicio de la casa de Dios, y en el cumplimiento de la ley y de los mandamientos, la hizo de todo corazón, buscando a su Dios; y prosperó.
es.R: En todo lo que emprendió, sirvió al templo de Dios y obedeció la ley y los mandamientos de Dios, porque quería buscar a su Dios. Puso todo su corazón en ello, y tuvo éxito.

fr.L: Et dans toute œuvre qu’il entreprit pour le service de la maison de Dieu, et dans la loi et dans le commandement, pour chercher son Dieu, il agit de tout son cœur, et il réussit.
fr.B: Toute œuvre qu’il entreprit pour le service de la maison de Dieu, et pour l’observation de la loi et des commandements, il l’accomplit de tout son cœur, en cherchant son Dieu ; et il réussit.
fr.R: Il a servi le temple de Dieu et il a obéi à la loi et aux commandements de Dieu dans tout ce qu’il a entrepris, parce qu’il voulait chercher son Dieu. Il y a mis tout son cœur, et il a réussi.

sw.L: Na katika kila kazi aliyoianza katika huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu, na katika sheria na katika amri, ili kumtafuta Mungu wake, aliifanya kwa moyo wake wote, akafanikiwa.
sw.B: Kila kazi aliyoianza katika huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu, na katika kushika sheria na amri, aliifanya kwa moyo wake wote, akimtafuta Mungu wake; naye akafanikiwa.
sw.R: Katika kila jambo alilolianza, alilihudumia hekalu la Mungu na kutii sheria na amri za Mungu, kwa sababu alitaka kumtafuta Mungu wake. Aliweka moyo wake wote katika kazi hiyo, naye akafanikiwa.

vi.L: Trong mọi công việc vua bắt đầu để phục vụ nhà Đức Chúa Trời, trong luật pháp và trong điều răn, để tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời mình, vua đã hết lòng làm, và vua được thịnh vượng.
vi.B: Mọi công việc vua bắt tay vào để phục vụ nhà Đức Chúa Trời, và để vâng giữ luật pháp và điều răn, vua đều hết lòng làm để tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời mình; và vua được thịnh vượng.
vi.R: Trong mọi việc vua bắt đầu làm, vua phục vụ đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời và vâng theo luật pháp và các điều răn của Đức Chúa Trời, vì vua muốn tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời mình. Vua hết lòng làm mọi việc, và vua được thành công.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 하나님의 집을 섬기는 일과 율법과 계명에서 그의 하나님을 찾으려고 시작한 모든 일을 그의 온 마음을 다하여 했고, 형통했다.
ko.B: 그는 하나님의 집을 섬기는 일이든 율법과 계명을 지키는 일이든, 시작한 모든 일을 온 마음을 다해 하며 그의 하나님을 찾았다. 그래서 그는 형통했다.
ko.R: 그는 하나님의 성전을 섬기는 일이든 하나님의 율법과 명령을 지키는 일이든, 무엇을 시작하든지 그의 하나님을 찾고자 했다. 그는 온 마음을 다해 그 일을 했고, 모든 일이 잘되었다.

decisions.choice: to seek his God: to turn to God, worship him and obey him
decisions.reason: Seeking God is a key thought in Chronicles: those who seek him find him and are blessed, and those who forsake him are forsaken (1 Chronicles 28:9; 2 Chronicles 15:2; 26:5). Hezekiah's work for the temple and the law is described as seeking God.

decisions.choice: he prospered: success follows faithfulness
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 18:7 says the same of Hezekiah: Yahweh was with him and he prospered. Chronicles links the success to his seeking God with all his heart, as it does with Uzziah (26:5) and with the words of Jehoshaphat (20:20).

decisions.choice: with all his heart: with his whole will and devotion
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will. To act with all one's heart is to hold nothing back (Deuteronomy 6:5; 2 Chronicles 15:15).

decisions.choice: in keeping the law and the commandments
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies "keeping" to show how the law and commandment belong in the list of his works.

decisions.choice: obeyed God's law and commands; because he wanted to seek his God
decisions.reason: Readable supplies "obeyed", names whose law it is, and turns "to seek his God" into the reason for his work.
